stem: In June 2026 the Luxembourg segment of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, has 10 businesses on Business Care at €45 a month and 3 businesses on Business Care Year, a plan billed at €480 a year, paid in advance. One of the businesses on the €45 plan joined in June and also paid a one-off €99 setup fee. What is the segment's MRR for June? Give euros with 2 decimals.
